system.description: The Grave Point skill. After a creature you can see loses HP, if it is in Crisis and not undead: gain 1 Grave Point, holding up to (SL + 1). When you hit 0 HP you lose all points — the first time each scene, if you lost at least one, your HP becomes (SL × points lost) instead. That substitution lands at 0 HP, so you never reach the Surrender-or-Sacrifice choice: Reaping prevents the fall rather than reversing it, and the Miasma Clock does not tick. Later falls in the same scene are ordinary, and those Surrenders land in full.
